events.title: REST listener for clinic API
events.summary: RESTful Web Service, Synchronous=true, resources build and parse.
events.rationale: This is request/response, not a queue. HTTP Post Synchronous=true is the 23R1 trap only when the transport never completes the ticket.

events.title: XML to EDI 270 with TableData
events.summary: EDITransformationProcessor XML to EDI using edi-tabledata/270-A1.
events.rationale: Playbook §3.5 — XSLT builds EDI XML, never concatenates ISA* as text.

events.title: Parse 271 with structural XSLT
events.summary: Clinic UI wraps the 271 in EdiPayload; XSLT tokenizes AAA/EB.
events.rationale: 23R1 EDI to XML for 271 has failed without licensed tables. TableData is still mounted for XML to EDI.
